name: Cash Clearing System
definition: Clearing system that processes only cash transfers.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Information used to identify a cash clearing system.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the category of cash clearing system, eg, cheque clearing.

CashSettlementSystem.name: Cash Settlement System
CashSettlementSystem.definition: Specifies the cash settlement system used.

TransactionAdministrator.name: Transaction Administrator
TransactionAdministrator.definition: Set of integrated applications that provides centralised services such as clearing and settlement.

SystemRole.name: System Role
SystemRole.definition: Specifies the role played by the cash clearing system.
